objective: Repository tools confine paths with apps/local-control/src/agent/tools/path-confinement.mjs, but a dangling symbolic link inside the repository (one whose target does not exist yet and lies outside the root) is treated as an ordinary missing file, so repository.write through it creates a file outside the repository. Make the real-path resolution follow a symbolic link even when its target is missing (resolve the link with lstat/readlink, then append the missing segments, with a bound on link depth) so repository.read and repository.write of such a link fail with PATH_ESCAPES_REPOSITORY and nothing is created outside. apps/local-control/tests/tool-families.test.mjs must pass.
